items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It’s a combination of a lot of things, from Basie to Ray Charles to Clark Terry to Nadia Boulanger. They don’t get any better than her.

ctx.x: When you think that you’re really one of a kind – who were the mentors? Who were the people? Because I can’t even find a model for what you do.
It’s a combination of a lot of things, from Basie to Ray Charles to Clark Terry to Nadia Boulanger. They don’t get any better than her.
I was going to ask about that.
